summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, attaching a press release announcing additional orders from its subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices for RIO Mini security trailers and ROSA stationary security devices, integrated with its SARA AI platform, for construction sites. The filing is a routine business update under Item 8.01 and is furnished, not filed, with no special-situation terms, financial details, or structural changes. No deal terms, board actions, or advisor mentions are present. This is a standard operational press release, not a special situation event.
